hints: Express the volume as $V = 40000h$ and state $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}h} = 40000$.
Write the net rate $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = 50000 - 600h$ and use the chain rule to show $200\dfrac{\mathrm{d}h}{\mathrm{d}t} = 250 - 3h$.
walkthrough:
Express the volume of water in the tank with base area $40000\text{ cm}^2$ and depth $h$ cm:
$$V = 40000h \implies \dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}h} = 40000$$

Write the net rate of change of volume:
$$\dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \text{Inflow} - \text{Outflow} = 50000 - 600h$$

Apply the chain rule connecting $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}h}{\mathrm{d}t}$ and $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t}$:
$$\dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}h} \cdot \dfrac{\mathrm{d}h}{\mathrm{d}t} \implies 40000\dfrac{\mathrm{d}h}{\mathrm{d}t} = 50000 - 600h$$

hints: Integrate to $-\dfrac{1}{3}\ln|250 - 3h| = \dfrac{t}{200} + C$, find $C$ using $t = 0, h = 50$, and find $t$ when $h = 80$.
walkthrough:
Apply the initial condition $h = 50$ when $t = 0$:
$$-\dfrac{1}{3}\ln|250 - 3(50)| = 0 + C$$
$$-\dfrac{1}{3}\ln(100) = C \implies C = -\dfrac{1}{3}\ln 100$$

Round correct to 2 significant figures:
$$t = 150 \text{ minutes}$$
